mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.25% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals a tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls > 0.2pp and PAYEMS rises > 50k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls > 0.2pp and PAYEMS rises > 50k.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market expansion (HOUST > 1000k units) and strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 11500), increased consumer spending drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1000 and GDPC1 > 11500.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production signals robust economic activity that supports corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises by more than 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 4.5%), strong consumer spending and corporate hiring support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 110.0, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110.0.
